parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own Techulus Push destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-techulus` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). On the Apprise channels the gateway composes an Apprise `push://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Four channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters; the `gateway` and `gateway-plus` channels skip Apprise, transform the envelope directly into a Techulus Push API JSON body, and post it to push.techulus.com. The `gateway` channel is free, while `gateway-plus` is $0.001 per message for extra per-enrollment Techulus destinations.

parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to Techulus Push API (no Apprise)
